description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 数据库名，默认为所有数据库。
查询结束时间，格式如：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，且大于查询开始时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The end time must be later than the start time.
The keyword used to filter queries.

description.zh: 小于某个时间跨度范围，单位为秒（s）。
description.en: The maxmum amount of time consumed by traces. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 大于某个时间跨度范围，单位为秒（s）。例如，100表示大于100秒的数据。
description.en: The minimum amount of time consumed by traces. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
排序字段和排序方式。

默认为`{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}`，表示按开始时间进行排序。暂不支持其他排序字段和排序方式。
description.en:
The field used to sort lock diagnostics records and the sorting order.

Default value: `{"Field":"StartTime","Type":"Desc"}`, which indicates that lock diagnostics records are sorted by the start time in descending order. No other values are supported.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The name of the database account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-active-sql-records --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --database testdb --user testuser --start-time 2021-08-03T09:30Z --end-time 2022-05-07T07:59Z --keyword SELECT --min-duration 300 --max-duration 600 --order Field_:_StartTime_,_Type_:_Desc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeActiveSQLRecords --region cn-hangzhou --Order 'Field_:_StartTime_,_Type_:_Desc' --User testuser --EndTime '2022-05-07T07:59Z' --Keyword SELECT --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp12ga6v69h860000' --Database testdb --StartTime '2021-08-03T09:30Z' --MaxDuration 600 --MinDuration 300
